dependencies.implemented: The parser/compiler emits timeline seek and interrupt-marker actions. Program executions share dynamic Blackboard state, invalidate skipped generations, reschedule natural ends, and cancel cast-bound child programs. CommandAdmissionProvider reads the confirmed Attack=0, NormalSkill=2, ComboSkill=5 and UltimateSkill=7 priorities from semantic mappings, then combines them with exclusive frames, AllowNext and MarkCanInterrupt. Eligibility uses the actor-local clock while the 30-frame expiry boundary stays strict. Every decision is exposed in commandAdmissionTrace, and all 43 observations match command frames and every HP damage packet.
dependencies.remaining: BreakingAttack has no captured INTERRUPT_CHECK priority and remains on a provisional external execution gate. Additional center-state pairs, named curves and projectile flight profiles still require independent cross-character boundary evidence before they can be generalized.
